subject: Operational synthesis: Priority customer realignment and stability cadence
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily@olivelogistics.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@olivelogistics.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency & 5xx spike — tonight's batch window impacted

Hi Lauren,

We saw a sharp latency increase and a 5xx error spike during our nightly batch ingestion window starting ~01:10am PT and lasting ~45 minutes. Our engineers captured the attached SLO heatmap and a sample trace (slo-metrics-olive-20270227.png). This period caused backpressure in our downstream processing and delayed delivery for ~12k events.

Key ask: we need a written timeline for RCA delivery, a short-term mitigation plan we can rely on for this week, and confirmation of whether this event will be considered a SLA incident for credit purposes.

Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Platform Engineering
Olive Logistics

Attachments: slo-metrics-olive-20270227.png
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@olivelogistics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe latency & 5xx spike — tonight's batch window impacted

Hi Emily — thanks for the signal and the artifacts. I'm very sorry for the disruption.

Immediate items:
- We will deliver an initial RCA summary by EOD Monday (02/29) with an engineering containment plan.
- Short-term mitigation: we can enable a targeted traffic-shed and KV-cache warmup for your tenant tonight; requires a 10-minute maintenance window.
- I'll escalate this to the on-call and org leads; KarThik will own the short-term mitigation.

Can you confirm a convenient 30-minute window for a bridge this afternoon to walk the trace and align on telemetry?

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Olive — first containment proposal and owners

Team — quick plan after reviewing Emily's trace:

1) Immediate containment (tonight) — KARTHIK (owner):
   - Enable tenant-level request-throttling to cap burst concurrency at 60% for the next 48h.
   - Pre-warm KV cache for prefix-heavy flows between 00:45–01:30 PT.
   - Roll this during a small maintenance; expect a 6–8% token-latency improvement based on sim runs.

2) Short RCA (due Mon 02/29 EOD) — JONAS (owner):
   - Collate runtime metrics, kernel selection logs, and routing decisions for 01:00–02:00 PT.
   - Hypothesis: a batch routing change + cache cold-start produced token-level amplification and an upstream timeout cascade.

3) Customer comms & credits assessment — BEN (owner):
   - Draft SLA-impact assessment and credit recommendation; coordinate with Finance/legal if necessary.

Attachments: operational_synthesis_20270228.xlsx (contains preliminary timeline and test plan)

Please acknowledge ownership and ping if you need runway to complete tasks. I'll book a 30-min bridge at 14:00 PT with Emily and Ravi.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhao <emily@olivelogistics.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@olivelogistics.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency & 5xx spike — tonight's batch window impacted

Thanks for the speedy plan. The 14:00 PT bridge works for us.

A couple of notes from our side ahead of the bridge:
- We maintain a hard SLA for final delivery of batch windows — this outage pushed 12k events beyond our 6-hour SLA.
- Please include the remediation timeline and whether the credit will be automatic or requires a formal claim.

We'll have our platform lead (Ravi) on the call; he can share internal logs and timelines.

Emily
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@olivelogistics.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@olivelogistics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Bridge notes + provisional credit recommendation

Thanks everyone for joining the bridge. Quick summary and agreed next steps: 

Summary:
- Root cause (working hypothesis): transient routing decision during autoscaling that selected a heavier kernel variant for a subset of shards; combined with KV cache cold starts it produced amplified token latency and a downstream timeout cascade.
- Containment performed: tenant throttling + cache warmup (rolled at 01:20 PT) — observed reduction in 5xx to baseline within ~6 minutes.

Agreed deliverables:
- Monday EOD (03/01): Jonas to deliver RCA packet (runtime logs + timeline + reproducer).
- Tue (03/02) morning: engineering patch to avoid the heavier-kernel routing regression (Karthik owner).
- Wed (03/03): Controlled canary rollout and performance validation across Olive test traffic.

Provisional credit recommendation (Ben):
- Recommend issuing a 5% credit against February hosted usage given SLA breach impacting delivery windows; formal approval needed from Legal/Finance. Ben will submit draft credit proposal by Tue EOD.

Attachments: credit-proposal-olive-20270301.pdf (draft)

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 07:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: Credit proposal for Olive Logistics (FYI)

Team — attaching the draft credit memo for internal approval (credit-proposal-olive-20270301.pdf). Key points:
- Proposed 5% credit of February billed usage tied to verified SLA impact window (00:45–02:00 PT on 02/27).
- Offer: auto-apply credit to March invoice upon sign-off to reduce administrative churn.
- Require Legal sign-off if the credit exceeds standard thresholds; Finance needs a quick confirmation for billing flow.

Next: Marissa, can you slot this for legal touch and add the billing run-owner to the thread?

Ben Carter
Account Strategy Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit-proposal-olive-20270301.pdf
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@olivelogistics.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@olivelogistics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Operational synthesis delivered — next steps and closure cadence

Emily/Ravi — attached is the operational synthesis pack that consolidates the RCA, timeline, and the mitigation cadence (operational_synthesis_20270228.xlsx). Highlights:

- RCA summary: confirmed routing decision + cache cold-start interaction as root cause; full log dump and reproducer included.
- Fix status: code patch deployed to staging; canary scheduled for Wed morning as committed.
- Credit: Ben's 5% recommendation is in process; Finance/legal review is in motion and appears routine.
- Ongoing cadence: suggested 2-week stabilization window with daily check-ins for the first 3 days, then every-other-day for the remainder.

Action owners and deadlines:
- Karthik: production patch and post-canary verification (03/02 morning).
- Jonas: final RCA write-up and postmortem artifacts (completed).
- Ben/Marissa: credit approval and billing flow (TBD 48h).

We will keep you updated in the shared drive folder and open a support ticket with automatic status updates. Expect a short note confirming the credit application after Finance signs off.

Thanks for your partnership; we appreciate the patience while we locked this down.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: operational_synthesis_20270228.xlsx
